items.text: v1.6.0 user-facing docs describe lifecycle as `plan -> truth -> generate -> evaluate -> release`, not `prd -> user-story -> test-case`.
v1.6.0 truth remains resolver-selected `features/<slug>/{truth,tests,tasks,evidence}.md`; generated JSON and legacy triptych surfaces cannot win authority.
Every v1.6.0 host-visible skill uses `beacon-<harness>-<function>` with harness in `planner/generator/evaluator/governor`.

v1.6.0 host-visible skill package does not retain old skill aliases such as `beacon-brainstorm`, `beacon-prd`, `beacon-user-story`, `beacon-test-case`, `beacon-implement`, `beacon-qa`, or `beacon-release`.
Every v1.6.0 host-visible skill includes the generated shared preamble covering lake/ocean, search-before-build, user sovereignty, no fake delivery, and harness boundary.
Planner skills may produce research/planning artifacts and route recommendations only; they cannot write implementation, frozen truth, QA verdicts, or release verdicts.
Generator skills may produce truth or implementation artifacts inside their authority, but cannot claim completion without evaluator evidence or use fake delivery as closure.
Evaluator skills judge evidence and route/block, but cannot rewrite truth or repair implementation as part of the verdict.
Governor skills manage context, archive, memory, hooks, automation, metadata, and status without becoming a human mainline stage.
A rough user prompt is first reduced to outcome, source/truth/evidence refs, lake/ocean classification, truth gap, test gap, implementation risk, verification risk, and recommended harness route.
Placeholder implementation, docs-only completion, fake runner evidence, zero assertions, or placeholder evidence cannot satisfy implementation, QA, or release closure.
Migration docs define old-to-new skill mapping, removal of host-visible old aliases, CLI compatibility boundary, and operator next steps.

v1.6.0 用户可见文档把生命周期描述为 `plan -> truth -> generate -> evaluate -> release`，而不是 `prd -> user-story -> test-case`。
v1.6.0 truth 仍由 resolver 选择的 `features/<slug>/{truth,tests,tasks,evidence}.md` 承载；generated JSON 和 legacy triptych surfaces 不能赢得 authority。
每个 v1.6.0 host-visible skill 都使用 `beacon-<harness>-<function>`，其中 harness 只能是 `planner/generator/evaluator/governor`。
v1.6.0 host-visible skill package 不保留旧 skill aliases，例如 `beacon-brainstorm`、`beacon-prd`、`beacon-user-story`、`beacon-test-case`、`beacon-implement`、`beacon-qa` 或 `beacon-release`。
每个 v1.6.0 host-visible skill 都包含共享生成 preamble，覆盖湖/海、先搜再造、用户主权、不假交付和 harness 边界。
Planner skills 只能产出 research/planning artifacts 和 route recommendations；不能写 implementation、frozen truth、QA verdicts 或 release verdicts。
Generator skills 可在自身 authority 内产出 truth 或 implementation artifacts，但不能缺少 evaluator evidence 就声称完成，也不能用 fake delivery 闭环。
Evaluator skills 负责判断 evidence 并 route/block，但不能改写 truth，也不能把修复 implementation 混入 verdict。
Governor skills 管理 context、archive、memory、hooks、automation、metadata 和 status，不能成为人类主链阶段。
粗粒度用户提示词必须先被归约为 outcome、source/truth/evidence refs、湖/海分类、truth gap、test gap、implementation risk、verification risk 和推荐 harness route。
Placeholder implementation、docs-only completion、fake runner evidence、zero assertions 或 placeholder evidence 都不能满足 implementation、QA 或 release closure。
Migration docs 必须定义 old-to-new skill mapping、旧 alias 移除、CLI compatibility boundary 和 operator next steps。
除非用户显式指定其他语言，Beacon v1.6.0 的需求真相、验收标准、测试断言、任务台账、迁移说明和 host-visible skill preamble 默认以中文为主语言；英文只能作为稳定术语或路径标识保留。
